title: WAMUL Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Graduate Apprentice Posts
description: The West Assam Milk Producers Cooperative Union Limited (WAMUL) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 01 Graduate Apprentice Post. Interested and eligibile candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed any degree or ITI can apply for the WAMUL Notification 2026. Interested applicants can apply in offline mode. Here we have mentioned the education details, age limit, selection process,...
